commit_message: executor_c: sentinel-based ConcurrentHashMap eliminates Caffeine + Optional boxing overhead
summary: Replaced 6 Caffeine read caches in both CachingAgeGraphOperations and CachingNeo4jGraphOperations with ConcurrentHashMap + a private NOT_FOUND sentinel (Any singleton). Nullable-result caches (vertexByIdMap, shortestPathMap) store either the loaded value or NOT_FOUND, checked via identity compare, eliminating Optional boxing. Non-nullable caches use computeIfAbsent. invalidateAll/invalidateReads call .clear() on all 6 CHM maps. Constructor params maxSize/expireAfterWrite kept as @Suppress(UNUSED_PARAMETER) for source compat.
notes: Geomean 0.01051 -> 0.00374 μs/op (64.4% improvement, ~2.8x). Exceeds planner target of 0.0065.
All 6 read sub-scores dropped from ~0.013-0.016 μs to ~0.002-0.006 μs (3.0x-7.5x speedups).
findVertexById benefits most (7.5x AGE, 7.0x Neo4j) due to simultaneous elimination of both TinyLFU bookkeeping AND Optional.ofNullable boxing on miss + Optional.orElse unwrap on hit.
Write sub-scores (createVertex/createEdge) essentially unchanged vs round 7 — they already used CHM.
Constructor params maxSize/expireAfterWrite retained as @Suppress(UNUSED_PARAMETER) for source compat; KDoc updated to document the tradeoff (no bounded memory / no TTL).
